newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.8 Jan 31 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.8 Jan 31 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) fell to 106.8 in the week ended January 31 from a revised 106.9 the prior week, ECRI said.
While the growth rate of real estate loans rose, the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries widened and the growth rate of industrial materials prices eased, ECRI said.
"The FIG is above its average over the preceding year ... (but) it has not yet risen enough to predict a cyclical upturn in inflation in the next few months," it said.
